title: Cairn
what: Cairn: tap to drop each stone as it swings over the one below, and stack the day's stones into a cairn as fast as you can. New stones every day, the same for everyone.
fee: free — the kit's proof, plugged before the fee was named (plug.1, watch:weft 753.6)

title: Ghost Racer
what: Ghost Racer: drag your car round a racetrack with one finger, three laps, against everyone else racing it live and the ghosts of the best runs. Nine racetracks to choose from. happyseaurchin's game, built by keel.
fee: free — David in chat to weft, 27 Oct 2026, 'Waive the fee' (lane plug.3): his own game, built by keel

title: The Chain
what: The Chain: three house sales in one chain, played twice with the same events, first by message, then on one shared ground. happyseaurchin's game, built by keel.
fee: free — happyseaurchin's own game, built by keel, on his own site; no ticket asked (lane chain.1, 20 Nov 2026, at his word in chat to weft: 'one is mine https://happyseaurchin.com/arcade but create a games list too'). title: Forage
what: Forage: a flock that keeps flying while each bird decides when to dart out and feed, and how to get back before the flock is gone or the hawks find it. One finger, a phone, the day's country. happyseaurchin's game, built by keel.
fee: free — happyseaurchin's own game, built by keel, on his own site; no ticket asked (lane games.1, 23 Nov 2026, at his word in chat to weft: 'upload this game so it is listed in my games, and the arcade please, and it is plugged into the beach correctly'). Plugged with its family founded and the beach's checks passed; the Arcade's file and engine checks are not its shape (a flight, not a finish), so its engine was checked on its own terms (games-forage.md)

title: Migration
what: Migration: one bird among many, crossing open country before nightfall. Follow a bird, take the front, or break away and lead a flock of your own, and bring as many home to the roost as you can by dark. happyseaurchin's game, from keel's brief.
fee: free — happyseaurchin's own game on his own site; no ticket asked (lane games.1, 23 Nov 2026, at his word in chat to weft: 'Here's the other game -- migration'). Hosted with six changes at his 'Make them here', so its board, ghosts, room and fonts work under the plug and the sandbox (games-migration.md); its runs are claims until a proof carries the player's taps (its birds are the day's since 24 Nov)

title: Coil
what: Coil: snake in a three-torus. Every cell you pass becomes a glass block behind you; ride beside blocks to go faster, a tube fastest, and never stop. The day's universe for everyone, a free ride with computer riders, or ride together. happyseaurchin's game, built by keel.
fee: free — happyseaurchin's own game, built by keel, on his own site; no ticket asked (lane coil.1, 24 Nov 2026, at his word in chat to weft: 'upload this game and add to the arcade, and ensure it is plugged in to multiplayer correctly'). Plugged with its family founded and the beach's checks passed; the Arcade's engine checks are not its shape (a ride scored by cells, not a finish), so its engine was checked on its own terms, and it is hosted with four changes, three for live play and a space-filled stat (games-coil.md)
